rules.sentence: Glaucoma has shown diminished N95 amplitude and prolonged implicit time in the PERG response.
Notably, glaucoma suspects have similarly shown prolonged N95 implicit time, although no significant attenuation in amplitude.
P50 is preserved in both glaucoma and glaucoma suspects.[18]

In particular, PERG responses in AD have shown significant amplitude reduction and prolonged implicit time in both N95 and P50, suggesting that retinal dysfunction in AD may involve the outer retina in addition to the inner retina.[20]
Studies have also provided evidence of retinal dysfunction in early AD.
PERG responses have shown decreased N95 and P50 amplitudes along with P50 implicit time prolongation.[21]
